questions.q: According to the Atlassian research cited, about how many meetings are unproductive?
a: Roughly half of them
Roughly one in ten of them
Roughly two thirds of them
Roughly a quarter of them
questions.why: Lesson 1 reports that around 50 percent of meetings are considered a waste of time.

questions.q: Why do meetings often fail to improve communication and connection?
a: People fear speaking up, and team roles are unclear
Managers refuse to share the meeting agenda
Remote tools make conversation too difficult
Teams meet too often to prepare properly
questions.why: Lesson 1 says members worry about sounding foolish and ambiguous roles leave everyone unaligned.

questions.q: Which four columns make up the Team Alignment Map?
a: Joint objectives, commitments, resources and risks
Goals, deadlines, budgets and responsibilities
Mission, period, agenda and action items
Strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats
questions.why: Lesson 2 lays out the map as joint objectives, joint commitments, joint resources and joint risks.

questions.q: What belongs in the header of the Team Alignment Map?
a: A mission and a period
A budget and a deadline
A leader and a note taker
A goal and a risk list
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the header holds the mission, which can include the agenda, and the period, which sets the time frame.

questions.q: How should a team leader prepare an agenda before a meeting?
a: Lay out time intervals and state what each part should achieve
List every possible topic and discuss them freely
Let members add items only once the meeting starts
Keep the agenda private to avoid influencing discussion
questions.why: Lesson 3 recommends planning the time for each topic and explaining what you expect from the team.
